entries.text: 大家好啊～[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_first_00

entries.text: 想被莉普我\n施魔法的是哪一位呀？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_first_01

entries.text: 所以我就搭飛翔計程車\n咻～一下地快快飛來嘍。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_02

entries.text: 莉普我的課程……對學生們來說\n有點刺激，沒關係嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_03

entries.text: 如果出了什麼事，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳會負起責任的對吧？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_04

entries.text: 嗯呵呵，莉普我的騎士\n真是可靠呀。\r\n但這只是開個玩笑而已，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳放心吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_05

entries.text: 嗯呵呵……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳擔心的樣子真可愛。\r\n只是開玩笑而已，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳放心吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_05b

entries.text: 非常榮幸\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再次邀請我來。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_00

entries.text: 話說，[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n記得莉普我的工作是什麼嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_01

entries.text: 空服員
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 崇尚自然藝術家
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 彩妝藝術家
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_select_03

entries.text:
不對不對喲，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。
雖說莉普我當起空服員也很適合就是了。\c
莉普我是個彩妝藝術家！
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要好好記住。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_02

entries.text:
不對不對喲，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。
那是某個奇怪藝術家的頭銜。\c
莉普我是個彩妝藝術家！
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要好好記住。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_02b

entries.text:
完美的答案！
莉普我是個彩妝藝術家！\c
雖說還兼任模特兒和
道館館主就是了。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_02c

entries.text: 這邊有很多人不認識莉普我，\n在告訴他們莉普我的工作之後，\r\n大家都非～常感興趣。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_03

entries.text: 莉普我在帕底亞算是個知名人士，\n但在海外也只是個普通人呢。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_04

entries.text: 既然如此，我可要趁這個機會讓全世界\n完美知道莉普我的美麗秘訣才行！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_05

entries.text: 對了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還記得和莉普我的約定嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能記住來自長輩的建議，\n真了不起呀。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_01

entries.text: 雖然這種假裝糊塗的角色也很可愛……\n但僅限現在這樣喔？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_01b

entries.text: 要讓自己的才能發揮到極致，\n不斷發光發熱的約定……[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_02

entries.text: 看來完全不用擔心！\n反倒是……嗯呵！\r\n莉普我甚至有點吃驚呢。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_03

entries.text: 如何？等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再長大一點，\n要不要來莉普我的公司工作呢？\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話肯定有實力站上世界舞台喔。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_04

entries.text: 拜託妳了！
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 怎麼辦好呢……？
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 嗯呵！\n這次就先不聽[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的回答了。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_05

entries.text: 忘記和莉普我的新約定，\n可不行不行喲。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_01_00

entries.text: 為了讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不要忘記……\n要不要和莉普我製造一些回憶呀？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_01_01

entries.text: ……對了！來和莉普我\n交換寶可夢吧！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_01_02

entries.text: 嗯呵呵！ 這才對嘛。\n莉普我這邊要送出飄飄雛，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要選哪個孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_01_03

entries.text:
竟然選擇[VAR 0x0101(0001)]，
嗯呵！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很有美觀意識喲。\c
我會把牠當成是[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，
溫柔地把牠私藏起來好好培育的。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那就用[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n來交換莉普我的飄飄雛囉？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_02_03

entries.text:
……不行不行喲，
只有１隻同行寶可夢是不可以交換的。\c
要是同行寶可夢有個２隻的話，
那還好說……[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_03_00

entries.text: 請在莉普我改變心意前再來。\n拜託嘍。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_03_01

entries.text: 嗯呵！等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很久了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要和莉普我交換飄飄雛了吧？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_trade_04_00

entries.text: 我說，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要不要和莉普我追求究極之美呢？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_talkto_00

entries.text: 哎呀，竟然拒絕莉普我的邀請，\n真是個大人物呢。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_cancel_00

entries.text: 嗯呵！就這麼說定嘍。\n我們到對戰場去吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: 不論是美麗或實力，\n都更加完美得簡直有魔法加持！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 很高興[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能遵守\n和莉普我的約定。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 如果是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，也許能超越莉普我\n成為超級大人物呢。\r\n我是不是該送[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳點好東西呢？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 那東西是很霹靂的喔。\n回禮就等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳以後出人頭地了再給我吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_gym_nomal_reward_00

entries.text: 在美麗上我們是平手喲。\n來，這是給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的一點小東西。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text:
無論是對戰上，還是美麗上，
莉普我都贏了呢。\c
但是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可不要灰心，
再接再厲，拜託嘍。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 莉普我雖然很忙，\n但只要是[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳叫我，\r\n我隨時都會快快趕來的喲。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 凰檗她有好好地\n在當老師嗎？\r\n她從以前就老是粗心大意的。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text:
一直維持同樣的姿勢不變
可是很不好的。\c
這種時候該怎麼辦呢？

狀況怎麼樣呢？\c
是不是一塊霹靂又強大，
讓人大吃一驚的好料子呀！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
